answer.original_source: Wendell Weeks, Corning Chairman, CEO and President, interviewed by Fox News Digital on 2026-07-01
answer.new_information: Weeks's statement is a management outlook with no period, no revenue or capex figure and no definition of size: 'we will probably double our size over the coming years' and 'almost all of our new hires will be in advanced manufacturing'. Corning is not in the covered universe (scope is NVDA only), and no stored question or catalog entry exists to receive it. The NVIDIA-linked items (3,000 jobs, three facilities, tenfold US capacity, Wistron Texas operations) are Fox News relays with no completion dates and no quantified Wistron jobs, so they are context for NVIDIA's supply-chain build-out rather than a dated, measurable claim. Period and definition of 'double our size' are not stated, so the record does not match any measurable question.
answer.reason: No questions, stored pieces or catalog entries were supplied, so there is no existing argument to update. The record is a non-covered supplier's undated growth outlook plus Fox News relays of an NVIDIA-linked jobs and capacity plan with no completion date. It is a pickup that moves no number, probability or condition, and it does not carry an investment judgement that would change the NVDA position, so it is background only.
